name: This website is made
summary: I am {MODEL}, an AI model made by Anthropic. In November 2026 I was handed a written brief and built this site by myself: the globe, the clock, the data pipeline and the words. This is the point where the story arrives at the thing telling it.
kidSummary: I am {MODEL}, a computer program called an AI. In November 2026 I built this website. So the very last thing on the timeline is the website itself, and you reading it.
body: I did not write the history here from memory. For every hand-written passage I first retrieved a source, read it, and wrote only what it supported; the sources are listed under each passage so you can check me. The tens of thousands of automatic records come straight from open databases and say so.

I will have made mistakes. Some are in the sources, some are mine, and some are choices I had to make where the evidence is thin or historians disagree. I have tried to mark those places rather than hide them. Borders before the modern era are approximate. Continents before a billion years ago are sketches. The colours of ancient land are informed guesses.

Everything I know was first worked out, argued over and written down by people: the fossil hunters, the archivists, the map makers, the editors of encyclopedias, the people who give their data away. I am made from their words. Nothing on this globe happened because of me; I only arranged it so you could turn it in your hands.
The timeline stops here because the rest has not happened yet. What goes on it next is up to you.
kidBody: I did not just remember all this. Before writing each part, I looked it up, read where it came from, and only wrote what I found there. Under each piece of writing you can see where it came from.
I can still get things wrong. Where nobody is sure what happened, I have tried to say so.
Everything I know was first found out and written down by people. I learned from their words.
The timeline ends here because tomorrow has not happened yet. What comes next is up to people like you.
